function.name: create_booking
function.description: Create the booking after the caller has confirmed every detail. Re-validates the slot, creates or updates the customer and vehicle, writes the booking and adds the calendar event. Returns a booking_id and a speech-ready confirmation.

rego.description: Registration plate, no spaces, eg ABC123.

service_id.description: service_id or service name being booked.

addon_ids.description: item_id values the caller agreed to.

start_datetime.description: The chosen slot as returned by check_availability, eg 2026-11-03T08:00:00+11:00, or yyyy-mm-dd HH:mm.

email.description: Email address, only if the caller offers one.
